answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 19295 Country: India Title: Please provide me the dua for getting married Question: Please provide me the dua for getting married.we are very stressed out because my last engegement was broken two years back.please provide me with any dua or wazifa. Answer ID: 19295 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 154-136/L=1431) You should recite ya Latif ( یا لطیف ) 1111 times after Isha Salah with durood 11 times before and after the dua. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
